text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the rehearsal for the "Mummy 
Hunt." Students who aren't part of the 
event staff will apparently be playing the 
role of guests.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Guess it's about time to get into 
position. Creek said she was preparin' the 
costumes and hasn't come back since... 
Wonder if she couldn't make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She'll probably catch up late, but... She 
ain't had much energy lately, so I'm 
worried. Seems like that ban on pamperin' 
really got to her...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, Inari. It's starting.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
BWAAARGH!! GIVE IIIT BAAAACK~~ THE 
TREASURE... MAH TREAAASUUUREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!! No, no, stay away~~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hide behind me. We'll fall back for now.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes... Lady... Oguri...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gehh~~~! What's with the "Lady Oguri" 
stuff?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, she's really playin' the part of a 
gallant hunter! We can't afford to fall 
behind either!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, is she on this floor or 
downstairs... Which way did Oguri――

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now!! Bang!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yay! We took one down! As expected of Lady 
Oguri~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tama... sorry. I leave the rest to ya...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Who'd have thought you'd ambush us 
under the stairs. That was a close one, 
good thing I dodged.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
――I will defeat you here too, Tama. I'll 
aim for the moment you turn to flee. This 
time, I won't miss...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
! Heh... Hahaha! This match ain't decided 
yet! ――Oguri, take a look behind ya!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufufu♪ I fo~und you♪ The "Mummy Who 
Wants to Pamper" is here~. Let's take a 
nice little nap together~~~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Get 'er, Creek!! Drag Oguri down into an 
eternal slumber!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Play dead! No matter what happens, 
pretend to be dead and ride it out!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~♪ Good girl, good girl~. Off to 
sleep~, off to sleep~~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-cha~n...? .................. ...Oh 
dear, did you fall asleep already...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Hurry up and take Oguri out of 
commission――

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's get Tama-chan changed too! I have a 
mummy costume ready for you. I'll help you 
change right now~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't need a costume!! Ah... Hey! Keep 
your eyes on Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufufufufufufu♪ Time to change~, 
let's get you changed~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why're ya comin' after me!! You just wanna 
pamper someone, don'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...The tables have turned!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
!! Creek, behind you! Oguri's revived! 
Catch her and pamper her to your heart's 
content!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okaa~~~~y♪ Ufufufu, Oguri-chan, 
squeeze~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmph...! D-Drat...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!! The reaction time honed from my 
comedic comebacks ain't just for show! If 
I do say so myself, that was a pretty 
great reaction!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mgh... I failed to read Tama's plan... To 
think she'd unleash Creek like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, Creek was downright terrifying!! 
...Guess that's the backlash from the 
pamperin' ban? Well, it makes her great as 
a mummy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
With Oguri and Creek gettin' into 
character, this "Mummy Hunt" is definitely 
gonna be a smash hit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is the end!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Look out, Creek!! ...Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan...! Ah, oh no... N-No way... you 
shielded me...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To put yourself on the line to shield your 
comrade... As expected of you, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, Tama-chan... I'm so sorry. I'll be... 
joining you soon...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mummy Tama... I will never forget our 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
............Wait, do we really need this 
whole melodrama...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That performance became the official 
scenario for when the mummies were wiped 
out, and the "Mummy Hunt" went on to 
receive rave reviews as a surprisingly 
tear-jerking haunted house.
